name: STRETCH
body: Make î or ĵ longer and the whole plane stretches that way. The arrow length IS the stretch factor.

name: SHEAR
body: Keep î where it is, slide ĵ sideways: the shape leans like a pushed deck of cards.

name: FLIP
body: Point one arrow backwards and the plane is mirrored. Its area becomes negative: it was turned over.

name: ROTATION
body: Turn î and ĵ together, keeping the square corner: the shape spins. 90°: î → (0, 1), ĵ → (−1, 0).

name: SWAP
body: Trade î and ĵ: the plane is mirrored across the diagonal. That is why the column order matters.

name: COMBO
body: Any two arrows make a transformation. Every matrix is just: where î goes, where ĵ goes.
